options {
	directory "/var/cache/bind";
	listen-on  {
		"any";
	};
	listen-on-v6  {
		"none";
	};
	allow-recursion {
		"any";
	};
	dnssec-validation auto;
	recursion yes;
	allow-query {
		"any";
	};
	allow-transfer  {
		"any";
	};
};
zone "isp-lab.example" {
	type primary;
	file "/etc/bind/zones/db.isp-lab.example";
	also-notify {
		172.28.7.12;
	};
	notify yes;
};
zone "cliente1.example" {
	type primary;
	file "/etc/bind/zones/db.cliente1.example";
};
